description: The AASTMT Alumni Center was established in August 1998 and it was the 1st official entity within the university to provide a focused and real service to the graduates. The association was established with an objective to create a solid community and strengthen the bond between AASTMT and its alumni through creating a lifetime relationship. We aim to ensure that our graduates stay in contact with us and their fellow alumni to learn and share experiences.

title: College of International Transport and Logistics - Latakia
description: The College of International Transport and Logistics (CITL) in Latakia, Syria, was established at the AASTMT Latakia branch in 2008. the College of International Transport and Logistics in Latakia serves as a key educational hub in Syria, providing specialized training and qualifications in the vital field of logistics and global trade, under the umbrella of the well-regarded Arab Academy for Science, Technology & Maritime Transport.

For instance, Electrical Power Engineer, Sales Engineer, Control Engineer. Electrical Vehicles This sector has a very impressive potential in the upcoming days so, that's why it was a must to offer students a program that helps understanding the construction and theory of operation of EVs. Also it is mandatory to integrate the theoretical information with a practical work that's why there is a well equipped EV lab that serve those courses.According to many references there are currently more than 15 electrical vehicle job opportunity available in Egypt and internationally; including positions such as low current project manger, warranty engineer, senior automotive engineer and also supervisor.

The association was established with an objective to create a solid community and strengthen the bond between AASTMT and its alumni through creating a lifetime relationship. We aim to ensure that our graduates stay in contact with us and their fellow alumni to learn and share experiences.
